title: 客户销售Top5
query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月实付金额合计最高的5个客户，返回客户名称和实付金额合计，不额外筛选订单状态。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT c.customer_name AS "客户名称", SUM(o.paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders_current AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-08-31' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY SUM(o.paid_amount) DESC LIMIT 5
